references.text: David and his men ate the showbread, which only priests were allowed to eat, a parallel to the disciples' actions in Mark 2:23.
The law allowing one to eat grain from a neighbor's field without using a sickle, which directly relates to the disciples' actions.
Jesus refers to David eating the showbread and to the priests' work on the Sabbath, as parallels to the event in Mark 2:23.
A parallel incident where Jesus defends the disciples' actions on the Sabbath.
